handmade: three articulated cut-card puppets A, B, C (FK rig, 15 bones each): designed silhouette pieces per bone (profile head with nose/lips/chin, B's wet hair mass and cut strands, C's patterned headband with knot tails, A's hat; blouse/shirt with bust, collar flaps, placket, buttons, tucked trousers and belt; rolled sleeve cuffs; mitten hands with thumbs; boots), split pins at joints, pencilled eyes/brows/mouth/ear/cheek hatching, charcoal-mud smears, sweat speculars L205-230, cut-edge darkening, drop and contact shadows
dry bag (roll-top oilcloth card, strap, buckle pin), plank (scored, bends under the occupant), torn-card banks with root fingers, twisted-paper liana

ledger lettering: Hershey script-complex single-stroke letters, each with its own baseline/size/lean jitter plus a smooth hand-wobble warp, graphite deposited by the paper scan's tooth; wobbly double strike line; C's card hand holding a card pencil follows the pen point
synthesized foley (kit Mix): bag rustle and thud, card click on the heel, drip, rustle as she rises, pencil strike and letter ticks, plank creaks and steps, splash noise
